name: demon
_about: A winged person (winged.js) with a demon's leather wings (winged.js leatherWing: the arm in two bones bent at the elbow, a hooked thumb claw at the wrist, four long jointed fingers, the skin between them in a fan of panels a shade apart, scalloped in between the tips and from the last finger back to the flank) and two horns from the brow (r, len: x the head's radius). The heroic physique (a V of a trunk, full arms), and the skin (skinLook) shaded from the chest out -- darker forearms, shins, hands and feet.
